_comment: Data-driven blocking story card (docs/HudSystem.md section 11a; Ravenmere G-116). Loaded by UI::loadGameScreenInto(ui,"narrative",...) into narrative:<panel> screens while GameScreen is in ScreenState::Narrative. {{narrative.title}}, {{narrative.text}} (paragraphs joined with blank lines) and {{narrative.button}} resolve via MenuActions.onResolveVariable; the button's "continue" action fires MenuActions.onContinue - the host then starts (or resumes) whatever the card was gating, and also continues on Enter / Space. 1280x720 virtual canvas. Sizing (HUD font, 14.6 px/char at textScale 2, 32 px lines): the body box holds 780 chars in three paragraphs (12 lines + 2 blank = 14 x 32 = 448 px of 460); the layout gate checks it at that length; the button holds a 19-character caption.
